title: Insert from URL inside Loop
description: Performance rule — Insert from URL inside a Loop fires a network request on every iteration.
author: fm-lab rules

rule.rationale: A network round-trip per iteration is slow and can rate-limit or time out.
rule.remediation: Batch the requests, or move the call out of the loop where possible.
